intro: I’ve always wanted to move to NYC, ever since I lived in Connecticut for 10 years as a kid. This desire only grew when I got addicted to How I Met Your Mother (greatest show ever made) and rewatched it 15 times (and counting).

I’ve never been in a place where literally anything you want to try or pick up is so easily accessible. Along with the people I’ve met along the way, it’s made my 20s the best experience I could have ever asked for.

I’ve been here almost five full years now and have lived in a few different neighborhoods, and I’ve only started to explore all the city has to offer. Here are some of my favorite places and moments in the city (a transplant’s view and a local’s nightmare, tbf lol).
